survey: A tiered garden topiary in a round stone-edged bed, set on a brick path. Main parts: (1) Four leafy tiers stacked on one vertical axis. They get smaller toward the top and end in a small pointed crown. Each tier sits directly on the one below, with a slight waist between them, as in a real clipped tiered or spiral topiary. (2) The bottom tier is the widest. Its base meets a mound of brown soil, so the plant is rooted and does not float. (3) The bed edging is a ring of curved stone blocks around the soil. The blocks follow a consistent circle and rest flat on the paving. Background props, which are not the object: a wooden bench, a pot of pink flowers, a lantern post, and a hedge wall. The topiary faces the camera from a slightly high three-quarter view, centered on the card.
